# 稀疏输入的人形机器人全身遥操作是否必须显式估计机身全局线速度？

> **当前答案：** 在 OmniH2O 报告的 Unitree H1、19-DoF、50 Hz 策略设置中，25 步本体感知与上一动作历史配合 DAgger 教师-学生蒸馏，可以不显式输入全局线速度；它在 20 条站立动作的实机评测中优于该论文测试的 VIO、MLP 和 GRU 速度输入变体，但该结论不能直接外推到其他机器人、传感器或动态动作。

## 可信度与审核状态

- **手册分级：** `L3 已审核工程结论`
- **分级说明：** 该结论已经通过 Handbook 的 EngineeringClaim 审核门槛。
- **置信度：** `0.78`
- **置信度理由：** The paper reports a controlled simulation ablation and a real-robot comparison, and the official commit exposes the corresponding history and DAgger implementation. Confidence is capped because the real-world quantitative set contains only 20 standing motions, broader demonstrations are mainly qualitative, and no independent cross-robot replication is included.
- **安全等级：** `caution`

## 关键术语

- 惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）
- 动作重定向（Motion Retargeting）
- 全身遥操作（Whole-Body Teleoperation）
- 门控循环单元（Gated Recurrent Unit, GRU）

## 适用机器人

- Unitree H1 research platform in the OmniH2O setup

## 适用模拟器

- Isaac Gym / PhysX in the official implementation

## 控制器与方法

- OmniH2O 19-DoF motion-tracking policy
- teacher-student DAgger distillation

## 适用环境

- retargeted and augmented AMASS motions
- reported 20-sequence real-robot standing-motion evaluation

## 成立假设

- The policy receives reliable joint position, joint velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, and previous actions.
- The motion goal is a sparse three-point head-and-hands kinematic target.
- Training uses a privileged teacher and DAgger-style action supervision in simulation.

## 排查与验证

- 先核对适用机器人、模拟器、控制器、环境和成立假设，再沿下方证据定位复核原始实验或实现。

## 结果

- 在 OmniH2O 报告的 Unitree H1、19-DoF、50 Hz 策略设置中，25 步本体感知与上一动作历史配合 DAgger 教师-学生蒸馏，可以不显式输入全局线速度；它在 20 条站立动作的实机评测中优于该论文测试的 VIO、MLP 和 GRU 速度输入变体，但该结论不能直接外推到其他机器人、传感器或动态动作。

## 限制

- The policy receives reliable joint position, joint velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, and previous actions.
- The motion goal is a sparse three-point head-and-hands kinematic target.
- Training uses a privileged teacher and DAgger-style action supervision in simulation.

## 证据

- [OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.08858v1>) — `support/primary`；Section 3 (student state and policy distillation), Table 1(a,b,d), and Table 2(a,b)；Supports the no-global-linear-velocity design, 25-step history, DAgger ablation, and reported real-robot comparison.
- [LeCAR-Lab/human2humanoid official OmniH2O implementation](<https://github.com/LeCAR-Lab/human2humanoid/tree/750f1fa052641f0fde43669d50cb4e407dabe6c8>) — `support/primary`；LeggedRobot.load_expert and LeggedRobot.step; OnPolicyRunner.learn; PPO._optimize_kin; H1TeleopCfg.domain_rand/control at commit 750f1fa；Maps the paper mechanism to teacher action labeling, history buffering, DAgger optimization, and the H1-specific training configuration.
